export.inputDigestDiscrepancy: The receipt inputSvgDigest/sceneSvgDigest do not equal captured public SVG UTF8 digest. No raw pre-export input SVG is supplied in this scope, so the precise cause and intended input byte correspondence remain unverified. Metadata and body/edge/visible-port correspondence do not remove this byte-binding gap.

visibleTextGeometryDifferences.classification: Visible text geometry difference; not solely an interaction or wrapper change.

pinRefusal.limitation: Public SVG omits pinnedObjects, and no rev18 envelope is in this scope. Selected object still has cancel-pin control and alias, refusal footer is present, and all XML geometry/content stays exact apart from two revision fields. This does not establish the complete post-refusal pin array or history internals.

compactCnn.limitation: This scope contains generated source and modal text, not a saved generated-model IR or a compact-CNN export copy. Constructor parameter and seven DAG connection correspondences are checked statically by parsing source; dialog claim of product static verification is not independently rerun or certified. Shape/dtype/runtime semantics are not execution-verified.

sourceChainReviewMethod.certifies: Captured JSON/XML and copied/live file correspondence only.
doesNotCertify: storage atomicity or persistence under restart/crash

dimensionsCorrection.reason: Earlier three reports assumed PNG structure from filename suffix and read bytes16:24 as IHDR. Raw files have JPEG SOI/JFIF and are decoded JPEG; those encoded-dimension metadata values and PNG encoding language are incorrect.
